metadata.name: Marketing Automation
metadata.hero: How is your marketing automation actually performing?
metadata.description: Answer marketing automation questions using Fivetran-synced data in BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks. Analyzes funnel velocity, lead lifecycle, nurture stream performance, email engagement, campaign performance, and lead source attribution. Today supports Marketo via the fivetran/marketo dbt package; designed to add HubSpot Marketing, Pardot, Iterable, Braze, and other marketing automation tools as separate connector options.

capabilities.name: Funnel Velocity
capabilities.description: Days between lead lifecycle stages (creation -> MQL -> SAL -> SQL -> opportunity) by cohort, source, or rep

capabilities.name: Lead Lifecycle
capabilities.description: Conversion rates at each stage of the lead funnel, with cohort and source breakdowns

capabilities.name: Nurture Performance
capabilities.description: Per-program performance for nurture streams: enter rate, exit rate, days in nurture, downstream conversion

capabilities.name: Email Engagement
capabilities.description: Send / delivery / open / click / unsubscribe / bounce rates by campaign, program, template, and time

capabilities.name: Best & Worst Emails
capabilities.description: Top and bottom email templates by open rate, click rate, unsubscribe rate

capabilities.name: Campaign Performance
capabilities.description: Engagement and conversion rolled up to campaign level, including SFDC campaign linkage

capabilities.name: Lead Source Attribution
capabilities.description: Volume and quality of leads by acquisition source; conversion rate and time-to-convert per source

capabilities.name: Engagement Scoring
capabilities.description: Behavior and demographic score trends; identify highly engaged and disengaged leads

example_questions: What's the average time from MQL to SQL this quarter?
Which nurture program is converting leads fastest?
Show me the top 10 email templates by click rate over the last 90 days
Which lead sources produce the highest conversion to opportunity?
Where are leads dropping off in the funnel?
Which programs have the highest unsubscribe rate?
How many leads entered each nurture stream last month, and how many exited?
Compare email open rates between batch and trigger campaigns this quarter

connector_groups.description: A marketing automation connector is required. Today: Marketo. Future: HubSpot Marketing, Pardot, Iterable, Braze, etc.

quickstart_models.description: dbt models produced by the fivetran/marketo package. The skill's funnel velocity, nurture analysis, and email engagement work require at minimum marketo__leads and marketo__email_sends. Funnel velocity over time additionally requires marketo__lead_history (daily lead snapshots).
